rows.text: Argas lies to the south of Dolos, a land perpetually tormented by drought, where sand dominates the terrain. A compassionate traveler passing through decided to seek plants from Cerces that could transform the desert. After enduring countless hardships, he finally obtained a blessed seed from Cerces, yet it perished in the dust before it could ever sprout. In his moment of despair, the traveler discovered that he himself was the one truly blessed. And so, he sowed himself into the earth. They say that to this day, he's still growing in the oasis.
